capabilities: Alert on unresolved conflicts in the active file
Review differences in a split-pane diff viewer
List all files with conflict copies in a Conflict Hub
Resolve conflicts in the open file
Merge conflicting copies of config, plugin, theme and snippet files
disambiguation: Not a sync service itself; it only cleans up conflict copies that an existing sync service creates.
extras: Warns that merged settings files may contain private tokens; old versions go to system trash or vault .trash, which sync or Git may upload. README includes unrelated developer release instructions.
intentEvidence: A simple plugin for conflict resolution. No more hunting through your file system.
problem: Cloud sync services (Dropbox, Google Drive, Syncthing) create duplicate conflict copies of notes and settings that users must find and fix manually in the file system.

relations.evidence: Sync services like Dropbox, Google Drive or Syncthing can also create conflict copies
Sync services like Dropbox, Google Drive or Syncthing can also create conflict copies
You don't need this with Obsidian Sync: it never creates conflict copies of settings

requires.name: a third-party sync service that creates conflict file copies

summary: Sync conflict resolver that detects conflict file copies, shows split-pane diffs, and merges or resolves them, including Obsidian config files.
